a: useContextMenu opens a keyboard-invoked context menu as a pointer one, so no row is highlighted
Space on a color, number or text row does nothing, where Enter opens its picker or field
AccessLabel folds a label's clusters differently from the access letter, so a final sigma is never underlined
A DOM menu taller than the viewport cannot be scrolled, and the keyboard highlight runs off screen
A modified release over a link row opens it with `window.open` and no `noopener`, handing the new page `window.opener`
b: A release over a color row presses it but never opens its picker, while a click on the same row does
A modified release on a link row opens the tab with `window.open` and no `noopener`, so the opened page gets `window.opener`
Text typed into a menu text or number row is thrown away when the menu is dismissed by a press outside or a window blur
A silently opened trigger menu drops focus to `<body>` when it closes while focus is in a color row's picker
Enter on the color picker's native color input pulls focus out to the panel, so the window blur from the native dialog then closes the menu
